restaurantRead.name: list_by_area
restaurantRead.description: Filter the owner's saved list (recs or want-to-go) by London neighbourhood. Case-insensitive substring match on the place's 'area' field.

name.description: Which list to search. 'recs' = places the owner has been to and liked. 'want-to-go' = wishlist.

area.description: Neighbourhood name to filter by, e.g. 'Shoreditch', 'Soho', 'Hackney'.

restaurantRead.name: find_place
restaurantRead.description: Fuzzy-match a place name across BOTH lists (recs and want-to-go). Returns matches sorted by similarity score.

query.description: Restaurant name to search for. Case-insensitive.

threshold.description: Minimum similarity score (0.0 to 1.0) for a match. Defaults to 0.6.

restaurantRead.name: walking_distance
restaurantRead.description: Compute walking time between two London locations using Google Distance Matrix. Returns walking_minutes and distance_meters.

from_area.description: Origin, e.g. 'Shoreditch, London' or a specific address.

restaurantRead.name: check_availability
restaurantRead.description: Check MOCKED reservation availability for a restaurant at a given time and party size. Returns available slots or a reason it's unavailable. Availability is stubbed data — treat results as suggestive not authoritative.

place_name.description: Restaurant name (as displayed on the saved list).

area.description: Neighbourhood, needed to disambiguate places with the same name.

restaurantRead.name: recent_visits
restaurantRead.description: List the owner's recent restaurant visits from the visit log, newest first, going back N days.

days.description: Look back this many days. Defaults to 30.

restaurantRead.name: visits_by_companion
restaurantRead.description: Filter the owner's visit log by companion name. Returns visits where the named person was present.

restaurantRead.name: get_list
restaurantRead.description: Return the ENTIRE contents of a saved list. Use sparingly — prefer list_by_area for area-filtered results.

restaurantRead.name: search_google_places
restaurantRead.description: Search Google Places (New) by text query, restricted to London. Returns up to 5 results with name, address, rating, price level, and hours. Use this to look up places NOT on the owner's lists (e.g. for adding).

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'best pizza' or a specific restaurant name.

area.description: London neighbourhood to bias results toward.

addPlace.name: add_place
addPlace.description: Owner-only. Add a new restaurant to the owner's 'recs' or 'want-to-go' list in S3. Requires actor_id to match the owner's WhatsApp number.

cuisine.description: Cuisine type. Defaults to 'unknown' if omitted.

google_place_id.description: Google Places ID. Obtain via search_google_places first.

note.description: Optional personal note about the place.

target_list.description: Which list to add to. Defaults to 'want-to-go'.

logVisit.name: log_visit
logVisit.description: Owner-only. Append a visit to the visit log and update the place record. If verdict='recommend' and place was on want-to-go, promotes it to recs. Requires actor_id to match the owner's WhatsApp number.

place_slug.description: The slug of the place visited (from recs.json or want-to-go.json). Use find_place first to resolve names to slugs.

verdict.description: How the owner felt about it. 'recommend' promotes want-to-go entries to recs.

companions.description: Names of people who came along.

note.description: Optional note. Overwrites the existing my_note on the place if provided.
